scope: Eight retained whole-building ExtensionBands, read-only Blender mesh/UV/image analysis, virtual N=1/N=2/N=3 translations only. No source save, derivative authoring, catalog change, native editor/generation or acceptance.

method.geometric_profile_sampling: Polygon cut edges at assembly lower/upper planes; both directed sampled distances, 5cm max nominal spacing (128 subdivisions cap per edge), endpoints included.
method.uv_sampling: First SourceRenderUV layer, per-loop edge interpolation, both directions, 20cm max nominal spacing (64 sample cap per edge), interior samples; same material and normal dot >=0.95 required.
method.texture_phase: UV delta reduced modulo integer periods for confirmed REPEAT wrap. Image RGB sampled bilinearly at pixel centers using confirmed identity UV mappings.
method.variation_test: N=2 adds one Repeat→Repeat seam; N=3 adds two identical seams up to a one-axis pitch translation. No native Cook/Bake, save/reopen or full-mesh intersection proof.
method.source_preservation: Each extension Blender hash compared before/after read-only opening and matched separate bank-owner extraction hash.
method.limits: Boundary sampling is not a volumetric overlap, window/door, façade architectural floor, collision/LOD, user visual acceptance, or Houdini Engine qualification test.

texture_receipts.sampler: REPEAT wrap and bilinear Linear pixel-center interpolation
texture_receipts.metric_space: Blender image pixel-buffer RGB; shader, filtering footprints, tangent basis, lighting and final native render are not sampled

families.preview_observation: Existing N=2 source render inspected. It shows retained family style and complete massing, but this distant single-angle preview does not establish seam close-up or all-side native continuity.
minimal_derivative_adaptation_proposal: Keep N=1 source reconstruction and source files unchanged. Scope any fix to new derivative N=2/N=3 variants.
Create UV/texture seam patches on derivative copies of the complete Repeat band and adjoining End boundary, retaining the existing source UV/materials on unaffected interior faces.

Use per-surface or per-UV-chart seam correction or narrow baked blend strips from the original diffuse and normal maps; a single whole-mesh UV offset has not been shown to preserve atlas features/openings.
Verify both boundaries and source-style features after patching; do not cure a repeat seam by changing the whole-family material or generic geometric scaling.

Where a true welded seam is required, align derivative cut-boundary profiles within the measured sub-1.5mm differences without changing the source assembly. Recheck roof/corner/vertical profiles and normals.
